description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Edgar (Poison/Fire/Lightning)] to user. Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if there are at least 4 VI party members, causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)] if not. Grants [Attach Poison with Stacking]/[Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Poison/Fire/Lightning.
